FINDING_ID: IM_F001
SEVERITY: 0.97
FLAW_CLASS: 2
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.93
DESCRIPTION: FIND: The supplied shim exports an interface that contradicts the stated analytical boundary. In the module docstring, the immune review boundary is declared as `_types.py + _immune.py + _manager.py`, but the same shim also imports `FailureHandler` and `CorrelatedFailureModel` from `bench.dm._failure_handler`, while the user’s analytical boundary explicitly includes `FailureHandler`. Evidence in the provided artifact: the docstring sentence `The immune layer review boundary is: _types.py + _immune.py + _manager.py.` conflicts with the import block `from bench.dm._failure_handler import ( FailureHandler, CorrelatedFailureModel, )`. This is not just documentation drift: it mis-scopes the review target and can exclude one of the named immune components from review.
PROPOSED_FIX: FIX: Replace the boundary statement so it matches the exported immune surface and the task definition.
<<<<
The immune layer review boundary is: _types.py + _immune.py + _manager.py.
====
The immune layer review boundary is: _types.py + _immune.py + _failure_handler.py + _manager.py.
>>>>
FOLLOW: This fix has downstream impact on review packaging and task decomposition metadata. Any reviewer instructions, decomposition manifests, or tooling that derive review scope from this docstring must be updated to include `_failure_handler.py`; otherwise future reviews will again omit `FailureHandler`, causing false completeness claims. It also means any “small enough for single-pass review” claim must be re-evaluated against the larger true boundary.

VERIFIED: TRUE

FINDING_ID: IM_F002
SEVERITY: 0.95
FLAW_CLASS: 4
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.98
DESCRIPTION: FIND: The artifact is insufficient to perform the requested immune-layer review, because none of the implementations inside the analytical boundary are present. The provided code is only a re-export shim plus comments; it contains no definitions for `DetectorDiagnosis`, `DetectorHealthMonitor`, `FailureHandler`, `_REMEDIATION_CHAINS`, `process_round()`, `apply_diagnosis()`, or `_apply_transform()`. Evidence: every relevant symbol is imported from `bench.dm.*`; no implementation body appears in the supplied artifact. Under the user’s task, findings must focus on immune behaviour, but immune behaviour is not inspectable here. This is a hard completeness failure in the review artifact, not a code-style issue.
PROPOSED_FIX: FIX: Replace the shim-only submission with the actual source files named in the analytical boundary, at minimum:
<<<<
=== ARTIFACT 1: Immune Response Layer (from dynamic_management.py) ===
"""dynamic_management.py — Backward-compatible re-export shim.
...

That upstream extraction logic must be corrected, or reviewers will keep receiving a shim instead of the actual immune code. No valid behavioural verification is possible until that upstream issue is fixed.

VERIFIED: TRUE
